steps.title: Welcome to the cockpit
steps.narration: This is Tapeology's home screen, where anyone can type in a stock ticker and watch live trade-by-trade tape reading unfold.
steps.point_out: The hint text shows you can try a built-in demo ticker, SIM-BUYER, right away — no live market data needed.

steps.title: Head to the Structure tab
steps.narration: One click on "Structure" in the top menu opens the newest part of the app — the team's price-level research.
steps.point_out: The page loads immediately with three sections stacked top to bottom.

steps.title: Choose a stock to look at
steps.narration: At the top of the Structure page, type in the stock symbol you want to examine.
steps.point_out: The field sits right where you'd expect it, no extra clicks needed.

steps.title: Choose a point in time
steps.narration: Then enter the exact date and time you want the chart to look back from.
steps.point_out: Both fields sit side by side, ready before you click Load.

steps.title: An honest answer, not a guess
steps.narration: Click Load, and the app tells you straight away whether it actually has recorded price history for that moment.
steps.point_out: This particular moment has no recorded price history loaded yet, so the app says so plainly instead of drawing up a fake chart.

expect.text: No bar series recorded for PG.

steps.title: Two strategies, side by side
steps.narration: Scroll down to the Registry to see both trading approaches laid out together, each with its own rules for entering and exiting a trade.
steps.point_out: A badge confirms which approach currently holds the title of champion — right now, the original one.

steps.title: Put both strategies to the test
steps.narration: Further down, the Comparison section lets anyone pick a recorded dataset and, with one click, run both strategies over it side by side.
steps.point_out: The champion box never changes from this screen, and a reference panel already shows a real, simulated profit-and-loss result, clearly labeled as not real money.

expect.text: founding baseline — strategy v1 on default

steps.title: Everything else still works
steps.narration: Last stop: the Performance page, opened from that same top menu, to confirm this deeper research work didn't disturb anything already running in the app.
steps.point_out: The same champion badge shows up here too, staying consistent everywhere it appears.
